inputs.title: Crab Nebula surrounding Gaia DR3 stellar field

inputs.acquisition: Compact checked-in extract of Gaia DR3 and Bailer-Jones geometric distance estimates. Exact source response hash, queries, limits and epochs remain in this JSON; no photo boundaries or invented depths.
inputs.license: CC-BY-4.0 distance catalogue; retain ESA/Gaia/DPAC, authors and GAVO acknowledgements.

attributions.evidence: https://dc.zah.uni-heidelberg.de/tableinfo/gaia.dr3lite — Gaia DR3 astrometry and G/BP/RP photometry, with EDR3-based Bailer-Jones geometric distance inference; catalogue extraction and exact query receipts are pinned in stellar-field.json. Bailer-Jones is a distance method, not another observing machine.
